The description states that the 'Търговия' (Trade) line starts at approximately 6 in 2011, but the chart shows it starts at a much lower value of approximately 2.5.
The description states that the 'Строителство' (Construction) line ends at approximately 25 in 2017, but the chart shows it reaches the highest value of all lines, at approximately 30.5.
The description states that the 'Услуги' (Services) line starts at approximately 1 in 2011, but the chart shows it starts at approximately 2.
